utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's keep the porch repair small and manageable on Saturday so we don't get overwhelmed. If folks ask, Vik can help repeat the plan and keep everyone moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, keep it simple and I’ll be there Saturday with the screwdriver and gloves. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik — bring the drill, screws, and the step ladder if you’ve got it. I’ll sort the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll bring the drill, screws, and step ladder, and I’ll be on the front porch at 9 a.m. I’ll keep repeating the Saturday porch repair plan if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep everyone posted, and I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Tess. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center and share any updates if they come up before then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I heard it moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’m keeping it simple for now and waiting on Rosa’s updated time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll wait for Rosa’s updated time too and keep things flexible for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Mina. I’m still on for Saturday and can help keep the porch work focused if you send me any updates.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send you any updates that come up. If anything’s still needed, I’ll keep it simple and let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll be there at 9 with the screwdriver and gloves. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren. We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the updated start time and list so you know exactly where to begin.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. Sunday at the community center works better, and I’ll keep it simple until Rosa confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep repeating the plan and wait on Rosa’s time before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s keep it small and manageable for Saturday so we don’t get stretched thin. If people ask, just point them to the porch plan and the door setup so we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Pia. I’ll point everyone to the porch plan and door setup and keep it small for Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
